question:
A nucleus undergoes $\beta^+$ decay:

$$P \rightarrow D + e^+ + \nu$$

Atomic masses (including electrons) are given:</br>
$M(P)=22.994124\,u$ and $M(D)=22.989770\,u$.</br>
Take $1u\,c^2=931.5\,\text{MeV}$ and electron rest energy $m_e c^2=0.511\,\text{MeV}$.

Ignoring recoil, find the $Q$-value.
